runtime.persistentMount: managed runtime remains mounted across semantic state changes; renderer swaps only on explicit experimental failure
runtime.fallbackPolicy: experimental failure -> production Nyx2DWebGL -> existing OperatorStage canonical 2D fallback if production also fails

lifecycle.hidden: stop RAF, mark motion clock paused, discard hidden elapsed on first resumed sample
lifecycle.reducedMotion: static neutral composition; no continuous motion
lifecycle.resume: preserve breathing/filter phase and use zero delta on first resumed sample
lifecycle.retarget: preserve accumulated motion clock and damped attention state

stateMapping.idle: breathing plus low attention response when a target exists
stateMapping.success: single frozen 1400 ms acknowledgement gesture plus 0.72 attention scale outside the gesture

experimentalStructuralEquivalent.note: SVG source-layer equivalents are conservative structural accounting, not WebGL GPU counters.

renderTime.diagnostic: data-nyx2d-performance=unverified while experimental runtime is animated
renderTime.reason: No actual project runtime/compositor capture was executable in the current environment. JS/SVG submission time is intentionally not presented as the 14 ms render budget metric.
